trade_cards.name: Long IM2609 / Short IH2609
trade_cards.structure: approximately long 4 IM2609 / short 7 IH2609, dollar-neutral
trade_cards.entry: Next trading day 09:30-10:15 BJT: require IM to outperform IH by at least another 0.35pct, breadth/technology turnover to stay supportive, and preferably fresh OI showing IM is not rising merely on a large OI collapse. At least two of three conditions required.
trade_cards.invalidation: IM-IH gives back more than 60% of the 2026-08-27 relative gain; IM discount widens below about -0.8% while IH basis stays stable; or small-cap/technology breadth collapses.
trade_cards.margin_and_gap_note: Actual broker margin must be used. Product spread has style-gap, basis, limit and margin-call risk; size so a plausible 3% adverse style gap keeps starter loss <=0.5% NAV.
